description:
☀Welcome to the PERFECT place for your large group to experience everything Music City has to offer!!! This rare find is in the heart of East Nashville, and a short walk to many bars, restaurants, and boutiques to fill a long weekend.☀

☀Quick and cheap Uber/Lyft to Downtown and Broadway.☀

☀Private off-street parking, Smart TVs, luxury beds, and a large open floor plan are just a few amenities to make this your Nashville home away from home.☀

☀We can't wait to host your Nashville Adventure!!!☀

The space
Nashville Short Term Rental Permit #: 2O21O57055

New property conveniently located to hit all of East Nashville's hot spots, and still just a short hop to Downtown and Broadway!

Three story home packed full of upscale, luxury and amenities to ensure your Nashville "home base" exceeds your wildest expectations!!!

Huge open floor plan, with large bedrooms, walk-in closets and upscale fixtures and furnishings!

Perfect for your large group!

4 Bedrooms + a Bunk Room for a total of 9 beds.

Sleeps 12+ comfortably.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire unit, as well as private, off-street parking behind the unit that will accommodate up to two vehicles.

Other things to note
- New Construction
- Private, off-street parking
- Keypad door locks with your own unique code for entry
- 2 Private balconies
- Multiple murals and photo backdrops
- Fully furnished kitchen for large groups
- Complimentary Coffee
- Smart TVs throughout
